title: 第15章 归元宗第16章 吞售丹
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 正当莫凡想要不顾一切发出最后一剑，然后等待死亡的时候，一柄剑突然在赤炎花斑虎身下出现，狠狠刺向刚刚莫凡刺中的地方。
由于刚刚那个部位已经被莫凡刺开了口子，这一剑很顺利地刺入赤炎花斑虎体内两尺深。然后，那柄剑还在赤炎花斑虎内搅动一番才拔出来。
赤炎花斑虎发出低沉的吼叫，然后“嘭”地一声落在地上，挣扎几息时间后，再无声息。
一道身影从赤炎花斑虎的尸体后慢慢站起来，是陆飞烟。
她刚才趁着赤炎花斑虎攻击莫凡，学着莫凡悄无声息地滚到赤炎花斑虎的身下，然后发出那致命一击。
陆飞烟走到莫凡跟前，看着脸色有些苍白的莫凡，问道：“你没事吧？”
“没事，谢谢你救了我一命。”莫凡摇摇头，站了起来。
“开始的时候你也救了我一命，咱们扯平了。”陆飞烟满不在乎地说。
“那不一样，那时候可能还没到致命的时候，刚才我是真的以为自己要死了。”莫凡道。
“行了行了，那就再加上我吃了你的烤肉，一起加起来，就可以扯平了。”陆飞烟笑道。
“好，那我就不矫情了。”莫凡心里一暖，觉得这陆飞烟心性还挺不错。但这份恩情他依然会记在心里。
“这就对了，一个男人磨磨唧唧的成什么样子。来解开这赤炎花斑虎吧，应该有兽丹。”说完就拉着莫凡走向赤炎花斑虎。
两人提着剑正准备剖开赤炎花斑虎的尸体，突然传来一道声音：“慢着！”
两人抬头看去，一群人朝着他们走来。
这群人一共有八人，五男三女，都是十几二十岁的少年。他们穿着统一的服饰，应该是同一宗门弟子。
为首的少年高高昂着头，神色倨傲，用鼻孔对着莫凡，说道：“这只赤炎花斑虎是我们发现并一路追踪而来，本来想引到这里再击杀之。没想到先被你们杀掉，我们就不计较了，赤炎花斑虎留下，你们走吧。”
说来，还挥了挥手，似乎要赶走一只苍蝇。
陆飞烟被这少年气坏了，叉腰瞪着少年：“你放屁，这赤炎花斑虎明明就是躲藏在丛林中，看到我们才攻击的，还你们先发现的，还要不要脸了？”
那少年并没有生气，脸上保持着傲然之色：“我说是我们发现的就是我们发现的。我们前两天就已经发现它，然后一直跟到这里。我说对吧？”
说完，他转头看向身后同行的七人。
那七人领会他的意思，马上七嘴八舌的回应：“王浩师兄说得对，就是我们发现的。”
“不是我们发现的，我们怎么会跟到这里来。”
“你们赶紧走，要不然给你们好看。”
陆飞烟被这些人气笑了：“见过不要脸的，但没见过这么不要脸的。想以多欺少是吧？”
“你要这么说也可以。”王浩淡然一笑。
“你们来自什么宗门？”陆飞烟问道。
“中域，归元宗。”王浩傲然答道。
content_en:
Just when Mo Fan was about to throw out the last sword desperately and wait for death, a sword suddenly appeared under the Red Flame Spotted Tiger and stabbed hard at the place where Mo Fan had just stabbed.
Since that part had already been stabbed open by Mo Fan, the sword penetrated two feet deep into the Red Flame Spotted Tiger's body smoothly. Then, the sword was stirred inside the Red Flame Spotted Tiger for a while before it was pulled out.
The Red Flame Spotted Tiger let out a low roar, and then fell to the ground with a bang. After struggling for a few breaths, it became silent again.
A figure slowly stood up from behind the body of the Chiyan Spotted Tiger, it was Lu Feiyan.
She had just taken advantage of the Red Flame Spotted Tiger to attack Mo Fan, imitating Mo Fan and quietly rolled under the Red Flame Spotted Tiger, and then delivered the fatal blow.
Lu Feiyan walked up to Mo Fan, looked at Mo Fan who looked a little pale, and asked: "Are you okay?"
"It's okay, thank you for saving my life." Mo Fan shook his head and stood up.
"You also saved my life in the beginning, so we're even." Lu Feiyan said nonchalantly.
"That's different. It might not be fatal at that time. I really thought I was going to die just now." Mo Fan said.
"Okay, okay, then add in the fact that I ate your barbecue, and if we add it up, we can even it out." Lu Feiyan said with a smile.
"Okay, then I won't be pretentious." Mo Fan felt warm in his heart and felt that Lu Feiyan was quite good-natured. But he will still remember this kindness in his heart.
"That's right, how can a man be so whiny? Let's unlock the Red Flame Spotted Tiger. There should be a beast elixir." After saying that, he pulled Mo Fan towards the Red Flame Spotted Tiger.
The two men were holding swords and were about to cut open the body of the Red Flame Spotted Tiger, when a voice suddenly came: "Wait a minute!"
The two looked up and saw a group of people walking towards them.
There were eight people in this group, five men and three women, all in their teens and twenties. They wear uniform clothes and should be disciples of the same sect.
The leading boy held his head high and looked arrogant. He pointed his nostrils at Mo Fan and said: "We found this Red Flame Spotted Tiger and followed it all the way. We originally wanted to lure it here and kill it. I didn't expect that you would kill it first, so we won't care. The Red Flame Spotted Tiger will stay and you can go."
Speaking of which, he waved his hand as if to drive away a fly.
Lu Feiyan was so angry at the young man that she put her hands on her hips and glared at him: "You fart, this red flame spotted tiger was obviously hiding in the jungle and only attacked us when it saw us. You guys discovered it first, why are you so shameless?"
The young man was not angry and kept a proud look on his face: "What I said we discovered is what we discovered. We discovered it two days ago and followed it all the way here. Am I right?"
After speaking, he turned to look at the seven people walking behind him.
The seven people understood what he meant and immediately responded: "Senior Brother Wang Hao is right, we discovered it."
"We didn't discover it, how could we come here?"
"You go away quickly, or I'll look good on you."
Lu Feiyan laughed at the popularity: "I have seen shameless people, but I have never seen such shameless people. You want to bully the few with more, right?"
"You can say that if you want." Wang Hao smiled calmly.
"What sect do you come from?" Lu Feiyan asked.
"Zhongyu, Guiyuan Sect." Wang Hao replied proudly.
